verdict.rationale: GA4 offers the Data API for programmatic report queries, including realtime and funnel reporting, filters and pagination, and an official MCP server published on GitHub, so an agent can query live analytics data to answer growth questions. The MCP server is presented as something to 'try', and its tool surface is not detailed in the evidence. missing for 10: documented MCP tool/query capabilities and GA status, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven querying.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent answer growth questions from live product data by running queries through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: You can use the Data API to programmatically access Google Analytics report data.
Try the MCP server for Google Analytics. Install from GitHub, and see the announcement for more details.
